name: Who is the killer?
source:
"Who is the killer?" is a short visual novel game about a detective who goes into a mission to a far kingdom to investigate about the death of the king. Your mission as the detective is to find the killer among 4 suspects!

[from [url=https://gameye.itch.io/who-is-the-killer]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《Who is the killer?》是一部短篇视觉小说。侦探奉命前往遥远王国，调查国王之死。作为侦探，你的任务，就是从四位嫌疑人中找出凶手！

[摘自[url=https://gameye.itch.io/who-is-the-killer]itch.io[/url]]
